This is a senior backend engineering role on Alpaca's market data team, focused on designing and scaling the mission-critical data provider services behind the company's brokerage APIs. The work spans stocks, options, crypto, and foreign exchange data products, including the architecture and public structure of streaming and historical endpoints, plus incident troubleshooting and code review. The core stack centers on Linux and POSIX-like systems, Docker and Kubernetes orchestration, SQL, shell scripting, and cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
